sources.title: Welcome to the Developer Blog at Cisco
Is Your VPN Ready for the Quantum Era? – IPsec Series, Part 1

facts.claim: Cisco positions itself as delivering critical infrastructure for organizations in the AI era.
facts.quote: Cisco delivers the critical infrastructure to help organizations thrive in the AI era.

facts.claim: Cisco describes its product strategy as a platform approach unifying products into integrated systems.
facts.quote: Cisco's platform approach unifies products into powerful systems that deliver greater value with less effort for your IT team

facts.claim: Cisco's careers messaging frames hiring around innovators building AI-era infrastructure.
facts.quote: We are looking for innovators to build the critical infrastructure for the AI era and beyond.

facts.claim: Cisco Foundation AI is described as a dedicated team building AI innovation for enterprise security.
facts.quote: Cisco Foundation AI is our team of engineers, researchers, and deep experts dedicated to open, bleeding-edge AI innovation for enterprise security.

facts.claim: Cisco's Webex AI team is described as building audio AI models for speech enhancement and noise removal.
facts.quote: Cisco’s Webex AI team is creating audio AI models that have never existed before to enhance speech and remove noise for millions of users

facts.claim: Cisco's developer blog describes Cisco as a software company central to digital transformation, not just networking hardware.
facts.quote: Cisco is a software company, playing a major role in this era of digital transformation.

facts.claim: Cisco's developer blog analyses how quantum computers threaten the key exchange behind IKEv2/IPsec VPN tunnels.
facts.quote: When two machines set up a secure channel (say, an IKEv2/IPsec VPN tunnel), that handshake rests on two distinct pillars

signals.text: Frame JD-relevant AI-era networking, security, or observability infrastructure experience around Cisco's stated focus on critical infrastructure for the AI era, when the candidate's own evidence supports it.

When JD coverage and claim safety are equal, prefer the supported bullet demonstrating unifying disparate systems into an integrated platform, aligned with Cisco's platform-approach product description.
Frame applied AI/ML security research experience around Cisco Foundation AI's stated focus on enterprise-security AI innovation, when supported by the candidate's own evidence.
When JD coverage and claim safety are equal for Webex-scoped roles, prefer the supported bullet demonstrating audio or speech ML system work.
Use Cisco's stated interest in innovators building critical infrastructure only as soft S0 framing language; never treat it as a technical requirement or keyword to insert.

When JD coverage and claim safety are equal, prefer the supported bullet demonstrating protocol-level networking, cryptography, or packet-level security work, aligned with Cisco's documented post-quantum IPsec engineering.
